title: Every golem: who is in charge
summary: The top level, shared by all four golems. The brain's activities pick between these; the task states below say what each task does once it runs.

states.name: DORMANT
states.note: No charge: stands where it is and does nothing. Only the core behaviours (swimming, looking) run.

states.name: UNEMPLOYED
states.note: Charged but without a chest of its own: wanders and looks for a chest to claim as its job site.

states.name: SEARCHING
states.note: Charged, with a chest. Every few seconds the dispatcher looks for the next thing to do, in a fixed order (see the dispatcher). Strolls near the chest between looks (not the hay golem, who stands still).

states.name: DEPOSITING
states.note: Task: carrying a stack, so takes it to the chest and puts it in. Always the first thing to do with a full hand.

states.name: FETCHING_SUPPLY
states.note: Task: empty-handed and the work needs a supply, so takes a stack of it out of the chest.

states.name: PICKING_UP
states.note: Task: walks to a stack lying near the chest and picks the whole stack up.

states.name: WORKING
states.note: Task: the profession's own job (farm, fell trees, dig rock, tend the pen). Which runner has its own diagram.

states.name: PANICKING
states.note: Hurt: runs away. Whatever task was running is dropped.

title: Visit the chest (put away / fetch a supply)
summary: Any golem. Walks to the spot in front of the chest, faces it, then plays the profession's clip; the lid, the hand-over and the close are each tied to a moment in that clip.

states.name: APPROACH
states.note: Walking to the spot in front of the chest (the side it faces). Never starts the clip anywhere else, and not while up on top of the chest.

states.name: REACH
states.note: Standing in front, clip playing, lid still shut.

states.name: OPEN
states.note: The lid is up (the chest is opened for the golem: lid animation and sound). Waiting for the hand to let go or take.

states.name: LET_GO
states.note: Put only: the hand has let go of the stack and it is on its way in.

states.name: TRANSFERRED
states.note: The stack is in the chest (put) or in the hand (fetch).

states.name: THROWN
states.note: Fetch, for golems that fling the stack out onto the grass to be picked up in the usual way.

states.name: CLOSED
states.note: Lid down; the clip is finishing.

states.name: DONE
states.note: (end) Task over. Interruptions close the lid and give back any stack the chest never took.

title: Pick up a lying stack
summary: Any golem with a free hand. Stands where the clip expects the stack to lie, crouches, and takes the whole stack.

states.name: WALK
states.note: Walking to the spot a set distance from the stack, facing it.

states.name: CROUCH
states.note: On the spot, clip playing, hand still empty.

states.name: RISE
states.note: The stack has reached the hand; the clip is finishing.

states.name: DONE
states.note: (end) Task over.

edges.when: settled on the spot
stack gone, hand already full, strayed over 12 blocks, or no path for 12 s (the stack is then ignored for 5 min)
the clip reaches its grab time: the stack moves into the hand
the clip ends without a grab (nothing left to take)
the clip ends

title: Farmer: reap a crop / sow seeds
summary: Hay golem. Stands a set distance from the plot, facing it, and plays the reap or sow clip; the crop is cut or the seed planted at a moment in the clip. Reaped crops are left to be picked up afterwards.

states.name: APPROACH
states.note: Walking to the spot a set distance from the plot.

states.name: WORKING
states.note: On the spot, the clip playing; the reap or sow has not happened yet.

states.name: FOLLOW_THROUGH
states.note: The crop is cut (or the seed planted); the clip is finishing.

states.name: DONE
states.note: (end) Task over.

edges.when: settled on the spot, facing the plot
the plot is no longer ripe / bare or the hands changed, or no path for 20 s
the clip reaches the harvest / plant moment
the clip ends without the act
the clip ends

title: Lumberjack: fell a tree, plant a sapling
summary: Mushroom golem. Walks to the foot of a tree, sneezes, vanishes and reappears on top of the crown, then mines straight down through the trunk. On the ground it steps back and plants a sapling. With no tree to fell it plants a new one instead.

states.name: WALK
states.note: Walking to within 3.5 blocks of the foot of the tree (or of the spot to plant, when there is no tree).

states.name: SNEEZE
states.note: Sneeze-and-vanish clip; a puff of spores at the end.

states.name: APPEAR
states.note: Teleported onto the crown; the appear clip plays.

states.name: BREAK
states.note: Standing on the top block of the trunk's column, the break clip playing; the block below breaks at the hit moment.

states.name: DESCEND
states.note: Swing done and the block is gone: waiting to land on the next block down.

states.name: STEP_BACK
states.note: On the ground (or planting only): walking to the spot beside the sapling place.

states.name: PLANT
states.note: Plant clip playing; the sapling goes in at the planting moment.

states.name: DONE
states.note: (end) Task over. If interrupted up in the tree he poofs back to the ground.

edges.when: within 3.5 blocks of the tree and there is room on top of the crown
no tree to fell (planting only), or no room on top of the crown
no path for 30 s (tree ignored for 2.5 min)

landed, and another log or leaf is directly below

standing on the planting spot with a sapling in hand
no sapling, the place is taken, no spot to stand, or no path for 30 s
plant clip ends

title: Miner: dig a batch of rock
summary: Stone golem. Digs up to a dozen exposed blocks bare-handed, one swing each, leaving the drops lying; then the pick-up and deposit tasks carry them to the chest.

states.name: SEEK
states.note: Choosing the next exposed block to dig (nearest first, skipping ones recently given up on).

states.name: APPROACH
states.note: Walking to a spot within reach of the block, looking at it.

states.name: SWING
states.note: In reach: the smash clip plays and a crack grows; the block breaks at the hit moment.

states.name: SETTLE
states.note: The block is gone and the golem is settling from the blow.

states.name: DONE
states.note: (end) Task over.

edges.when: a block was found (the first one comes with the plan)
twelve blocks dug, or no rock left in reach of the chest
within reach with a clear line to the block
the block is already gone or no longer safe to cut, or unreachable for 8 s (ignored for 5 min)
hit moment: the block breaks, the drops fall
the swing has settled

title: Herder: cull, shear, milk, feed
summary: Terracotta golem. Walks to an animal in a pen, stands where the clip wants it (the animal is held where the arms go), and plays the clip for the job; the deed itself lands at a moment in the clip.

states.name: WALK
states.note: Walking towards the animal, until within 4 blocks.

states.name: STAGE
states.note: Within reach: choosing and settling onto the spot (one of eight facings) the clip is written for.

states.name: PLAY
states.note: Clip playing, the animal frozen in place; the deed has not happened yet.

states.name: FOLLOW_THROUGH
states.note: The deed is done (culled, sheared, milked or fed); the clip is finishing.

states.name: DONE
states.note: (end) Task over.

edges.when: within 4 blocks of the animal
the animal is gone, or 20 s without reaching it
the animal wandered out of reach
standing on the spot facing the right way (milking needs no spot)
no room to stage it (does the job without the show), the animal is gone, or 20 s
the clip reaches the deed's moment
the animal vanished first, or the clip ends
